---
title: App Icons List
---
Each Quasar CLI mode uses a different set of icons and, where applicable, splash screens.
Icon Genie creates the appropriate assets through its [generate](command-list.md#generate) command.

Here are the links to each mode's list:

| Quasar Mode | Link |
| --- | --- |
| App icons for SPA mode | [SPA mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-spa/app-icons-spa.md) |
| App icons for PWA mode | [PWA mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-pwa/app-icons-pwa.md) |
| App icons for SSR mode | [SSR mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-ssr/app-icons-ssr.md) |
| App icons for SSG mode | [SSG mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-ssg/app-icons-ssg.md) |
| App icons for Capacitor mode | [Capacitor mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-capacitor-apps/app-icons-capacitor.md) |
| App icons for Cordova mode | [Cordova mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-cordova-apps/app-icons-cordova.md) |
| App icons for Electron mode | [Electron mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-electron-apps/app-icons-electron.md) |
| App icons for BEX mode | [BEX mode](../quasar-cli-vite/developing-browser-extensions/app-icons-browser-extension.md) |
